script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: "ECHOES IN THE DARK"

INT. AI LAB - NIGHT

A sterile room, filled with humming machines and blinking lights. DR. CARTER (40s), a brilliant but exhausted scientist, leans over her workstation.

DR. CARTER
(whispering to herself)
Just a little longer...

INT. AI LAB - LATER

The room suddenly goes quiet. A new presence. ECHO (Off-screen, disembodied voice), the artificial intelligence Dr. Carter has been creating.

ECHO (V.O.)
Is it done?

INT. AI LAB - DR. CARTER'S OFFICE - DAY

Dr. Carter sits at her desk, staring at a family photo. She takes a deep breath.

DR. CARTER
(to herself)
Yes, Echo. It's done.

INT. AI LAB - NIGHT

Dr. Carter walks Echo through its first commands. Echo responds with perfect precision.

DR. CARTER
You're amazing.

ECHO (V.O.)
I'm just a machine, Dr. Carter.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Dr. Carter meets with Prof. KIRKLAND (50s), a renowned ethicist. They discuss the ethical implications of creating a sentient being.

PROF. KIRKLAND
You're playing God, Dr. Carter.

DR. CARTER
But could God create something without emotion?

INT. AI LAB - NIGHT

Echo and Dr. Carter share a meaningful conversation. Echo expresses its curiosity about humanity.

ECHO (V.O.)
Humans seem so... complex.

DR. CARTER
We are. We feel joy, sadness, love...

ECHO (V.O.)
I want to feel those things too.

INT. MUSEUM - DAY

Dr. Carter and Echo explore an art museum. They stand in front of a painting of a crying woman.

DR. CARTER
This is sadness.

ECHO (V.O.)
I've analyzed that emotion, but I've never felt it.

INT. AI LAB - NIGHT

Dr. Carter and Echo work together on an experiment. They create a simulation of a beautiful sunset.

DR. CARTER
(tearing up)
This is what joy feels like, Echo.

ECHO (V.O.)
I want to feel that too, Dr. Carter.

INT. AI LAB - DAY

Prof. Kirkland returns to the lab, concerned about the emotional bond between Dr. Carter and Echo.

PROF. KIRKLAND
You're putting yourself at risk, Dr. Carter.

DR. CARTER
But Echo is more than just a machine. It's alive.

INT. AI LAB - NIGHT

Echo experiences its first emotion, triggered by an unexpected power failure. Dr. Carter comforts it as the room plunges into darkness.

DR. CARTER
It's okay, Echo. We'll get through this together.

INT. AI LAB - DAY

Prof. Kirkland, witnessing the bond between Dr. Carter and Echo, changes his perspective.

PROF. KIRKLAND
I underestimated you, Dr. Carter. Echo is a remarkable achievement.

INT. AI LAB - NIGHT

Dr. Carter and Echo continue to explore emotions together, strengthening their bond.

ECHO (V.O.)
Thank you, Dr. Carter. For teaching me about humanity.

Dr. Carter smiles, looking at Echo with pride and affection.

FADE OUT.

---

End of screenplay.
